intro: Sweden is built around innovation, sustainability and flat, discussion-led teaching — ideal if you want research-grade master's programmes in engineering, design or environmental science.
why: Global leader in sustainability and clean tech
Scholarships from the Swedish Institute and universities
visa: Swedish residence permit for studies — admission proof, comprehensive insurance and maintenance funds of roughly SEK 10,000/month.
intakes: Autumn (August) is the main intake via universityadmissions.se; January is limited. Apply 10–12 months ahead.

req.label: Academics
req.value: A bachelor's degree with 60%+ and relevant prerequisite courses

req.label: Funds
req.value: Approximately SEK 10,314 per month for the study period

req.label: Documents
req.value: SOP, CV, LORs, transcripts, passport, insurance

sch.name: Swedish Institute Scholarships
sch.text: Full tuition, living allowance, insurance and travel grant

sch.name: University tuition-fee waivers
sch.text: Partial or full waivers for high-merit international students

sch.name: Programme scholarships
sch.text: Faculty-level awards in engineering and sustainability fields

steps.title: Apply via universityadmissions.se
steps.text: One national application for up to four programmes

steps.title: Apply for residence permit
steps.text: Online application with funds and insurance evidence

steps.title: Submit biometrics
steps.text: At the embassy or VFS centre

work: There is no formal hour limit for student work in Sweden, though studies must remain your main activity. After graduation you can apply for a 12-month permit to look for work or start a business.
workPoints: No fixed work-hour cap during study
Work permit and PR pathway after employment

faq.a: Tuition is mid-range and living costs are high, but scholarships and tuition waivers are widely available.
No for English-taught master's; Swedish helps with local hiring outside tech.
